lines.zh: 脊骨先压低，我贴着洞穴的岩壁走。
lines.en: I keep my spine low and walk against the cave wall.

lines.zh: 传说维度的蕨叶太矮，遮不住我的背刺。
lines.en: The ferns of Precasia are too short to hide my spines.

lines.zh: 四只爪子轮流落地，丛林里没有回声。
lines.en: Four claws take turns; the jungle gives back no echo.

lines.zh: 我独自巡猎，脚印从不与谁重合。
lines.en: I hunt alone, and my tracks never overlap anyone else's.

lines.zh: 平原上风很直，我的尾尖拖着它走。
lines.en: On the plains the wind runs straight, dragging behind my tail.

lines.zh: 别踩那片断枝，那是我留下的路标。
lines.en: Do not step on the broken twigs; I left them as markers.

lines.zh: 洞穴越深，我的鳞片越凉。
lines.en: Deeper into the cave, my scales grow colder.

lines.zh: 我每一步都攒着能撕开甲壳的力气。
lines.en: Every step stores enough force to split a shell.

lines.zh: 森林的影子追不上我，只追得上落叶。
lines.en: The forest's shadow cannot keep up, only the falling leaves can.

lines.zh: 我嗅到温热的东西，脚就自己转向。
lines.en: I smell something warm, and my feet turn on their own.

lines.zh: 背上的刺擦过树干，掉下一层木屑。
lines.en: My spines scrape a trunk and a layer of bark falls.

lines.zh: 别跟着我的爪印，它们绕的是死路。
lines.en: Do not follow my claw marks; they loop toward dead ends.

lines.zh: 我数着自己背上的刺，数到一半就忘。
lines.en: I count the spines on my back and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 洞穴滴水，我张嘴接，像在磨牙。
lines.en: Cave water drips; I open my jaw and let it grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 鳞甲四层厚，痒的时候挠不到。
lines.en: Four layers of scale, and I cannot scratch the itch.

lines.zh: 我趴在暖石上，把腹部摊平。
lines.en: I lie on a warm stone and spread my belly flat.

lines.zh: 丛林安静得像在等我先动。
lines.en: The jungle is silent, as if waiting for me to move first.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过落叶，声音比我还大。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the leaves and makes more noise than I do.

lines.zh: 传说维度的风里有铁锈味。
lines.en: The wind of Precasia carries the smell of rust.

lines.zh: 我老想着，这洞穴是谁先挖的。
lines.en: I keep wondering who dug this cave first.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过我的爪子，我放它走。
lines.en: A beetle crosses my claw, and I let it pass.

lines.zh: 背刺在暗处也会反一点光。
lines.en: Even in the dark my spines give back a little light.

lines.zh: 我抬头，洞顶离我只有一次扑击。
lines.en: I look up; the roof is one lunge away.

lines.zh: 没有同伴，我的呼吸就是这片的节拍。
lines.en: No pack, so my breathing sets the rhythm here.

lines.zh: 我把爪子插进土里，量这块地有多软。
lines.en: I sink my claws into the soil to measure its softness.

lines.zh: 平原有野兔的味道，我还没动。
lines.en: The plains smell of hares, and I have not moved yet.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，像一根还没折断的树枝。
lines.en: You stand straight, like a branch not yet broken.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有甲，四层厚的那种。
lines.en: I am checking whether you have armor, four layers thick.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，我的瞳孔跟着缩。
lines.en: Your eyes move, and my pupils narrow after them.

lines.zh: 别把手伸向背刺，那不是我愿意的事。
lines.en: Do not reach for the spines; that is not my choice to make.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，比洞穴的石头更近。
lines.en: The iron on you smells closer than the cave stones.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为你比我见过的猎物高。
lines.en: I tilt my head because you stand taller than my usual prey.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我的尾巴就松了一点。
lines.en: You take one step back, and my tail loosens a little.

lines.zh: 我在等你的手先动。
lines.en: I am waiting for your hand to move first.

lines.zh: 你看我的背，我看你的喉咙。
lines.en: You look at my back; I look at your throat.

lines.zh: 丛林说你是新的，我听不懂新。
lines.en: The jungle says you are new; I do not understand new.

lines.zh: 你的影子太短，短得不像猎人。
lines.en: Your shadow is too short to belong to a hunter.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，这是最后的礼数。
lines.en: I lower my head; that is the last courtesy I give.

lines.zh: 你砍开了鳞，但没砍到骨头。
lines.en: You split the scale but did not reach bone.

lines.zh: 痛让我想起洞穴的冬天。
lines.en: Pain reminds me of winter in the cave.

lines.zh: 我的血很热，落在石头上会冒气。
lines.en: My blood is hot and steams when it hits stone.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，你的味道也是。
lines.en: I will remember this blow, and your smell.

lines.zh: 四层甲挡了三层，剩下那层归你。
lines.en: Four layers stopped three; the last layer is yours.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，可不是要逃。
lines.en: I stepped back, but not to flee.

lines.zh: 背刺断了一根，我会长回来的。
lines.en: One spine broke; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 你的剑比我预想的快。
lines.en: Your blade is faster than I expected.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我咬得更紧。
lines.en: When it hurts, I bite harder.

lines.zh: 别高兴太早，我还能跑。
lines.en: Do not celebrate yet; I can still run.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道让我忘了刚才要咬谁。
lines.en: The smell of raw meat makes me forget whom I meant to bite.

lines.zh: 你把肉放低一点，我的爪就不会抖。
lines.en: Set the meat lower, and my claws will stop shaking.

lines.zh: 我不是被驯服的，只是饿了。
lines.en: I am not tamed, only hungry.

lines.zh: 那块肉落地，我的耐心也落地。
lines.en: The meat lands, and so does my patience.

lines.zh: 我嗅到血腥，脑子里只剩一个念头。
lines.en: I smell blood, and only one thought remains.

lines.zh: 别用骨头逗我，我会连手一起咬。
lines.en: Do not tease me with bones; I will bite the hand too.

lines.zh: 我低头不是臣服，是要看清那块肉。
lines.en: I bow my head not to submit, but to see the meat clearly.

lines.zh: 传说维度的猎物太少，我不挑。
lines.en: Prey is scarce in Precasia; I do not pick.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西香得像刚死的鹿。
lines.en: What you hold smells like a deer that just died.

lines.zh: 食物在前，我的独居原则就碎了。
lines.en: With food ahead, my solitary rule cracks.

lines.zh: 别撞我侧面，那里没有刺护着。
lines.en: Do not hit my flank; no spines guard that side.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是四层鳞，不是石头。
lines.en: What you struck is four layers of scale, not stone.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛比你以为的更硬。
lines.en: My shoulder plate is harder than you assumed.

lines.zh: 退开，我不想为一次碰撞浪费牙。
lines.en: Back off; I will not waste my teeth on a bump.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，声音在洞穴里滚。
lines.en: Bone meets bone, and the sound rolls through the cave.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，谁都转不了身。
lines.en: Pressed together, neither of us can turn around.

lines.zh: 你的甲撞裂了我一根刺尖。
lines.en: Your armor chipped one tip of my spine.

lines.zh: 丛林的地面太软，撞起来没意思。
lines.en: The jungle floor is too soft for a decent collision.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴撑地，才没被你推倒。
lines.en: I braced with my tail so you could not push me down.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就把它当成开战。
lines.en: Bump me again and I will take it as a declaration.

lines.zh: 我这辈子只找过一次同类，然后走了。
lines.en: I sought my own kind once, then walked away.

lines.zh: 同类靠近时，我先把刺竖起来。
lines.en: When my kind come close, I raise my spines first.

lines.zh: 独居的猎手不谈陪伴，只谈边界。
lines.en: A solitary hunter speaks of borders, not company.

lines.zh: 她闻了闻我的爪，就走进了蕨丛。
lines.en: She sniffed my claw and walked into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站了一会儿，就各自饿了。
lines.en: We stood side by side a while, then each grew hungry.

lines.zh: 传说维度的春天很短，短得像一次低头。
lines.en: Spring in Precasia is short, like one lowered head.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，洞穴就是我的巢。
lines.en: I build no nest; the cave is nest enough.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的好感也有牙。
lines.en: Do not come closer; even my affection has teeth.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴并排扫过落叶，声音很轻。
lines.en: Two tails sweep the leaves in parallel, softly.

lines.zh: 之后我们各走各的，这样最好。
lines.en: Afterward we part ways; that is best.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根骨头，像叼着一小段路。
lines.en: I pick up a bone as if carrying a short road.

lines.zh: 这块肉我留着，等洞穴更暗的时候。
lines.en: I keep this meat for when the cave grows darker.

lines.zh: 爪子不擅长拿东西，但我还是试了。
lines.en: Claws are poor at holding things, but I tried.

lines.zh: 我把骨头埋进软土，回头再来。
lines.en: I bury the bone in soft soil and will return.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我也捡，虽然不能吃。
lines.en: I pick up shiny things too, though they cannot be eaten.

lines.zh: 别看我叼东西，那只是我的晚饭。
lines.en: Do not stare at what I carry; it is only dinner.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满，我就暂时不咬人。
lines.en: With my mouth full, I will not bite for now.

lines.zh: 这块布有铁味，我叼去垫爪子。
lines.en: This cloth smells of iron; I will line my claws with it.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用下巴推着走。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I push it along with my jaw.

lines.zh: 我一松口，东西就掉进了蕨丛。
lines.en: I open my jaw and it falls into the ferns.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的热气在我鼻子里放大了。
lines.en: The warmth of your breath grows loud in my nose.

lines.zh: 我锁定的是你的膝盖，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I fix on your knees, not your face.

lines.zh: 九点五点的力气，我只需一次机会。
lines.en: Nine and a half points of force; I need one chance.

lines.zh: 传说维度的猎手不需要喊叫。
lines.en: A hunter of Precasia needs no war cry.

lines.zh: 你身上没有甲，那事情就简单了。
lines.en: You wear no armor, which makes this simple.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔缩成一条线，你该跑。
lines.en: My pupils narrow to a line; you should run.

lines.zh: 洞穴的回声帮你藏了脚步，可惜太晚。
lines.en: The cave echo hid your steps, but too late.

lines.zh: 我数完你的距离，就数你还有几步。
lines.en: I measure your distance, then how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 背刺竖起来的时候，猎杀就开始了。
lines.en: When my spines rise, the hunt has begun.

lines.zh: 你动了，我的爪子先于念头出发。
lines.en: You move, and my claws leave before the thought.

lines.zh: 我选了你，因为你在平原上太显眼。
lines.en: I chose you because you stand out on the plains.

lines.zh: 别往丛林跑，那里我比你熟。
lines.en: Do not run to the jungle; I know it better than you.

lines.zh: 我已经闻到你的汗了。
lines.en: I can already smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 锁定了，我连呼吸都省了。
lines.en: Locked on; I even stop breathing.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，让你的盾偏到左边。
lines.en: I circle half a turn so your shield slides left.

lines.zh: 我不急，急的是你。
lines.en: I am not hurried; you are.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你后退的方向上。
lines.en: Every step I take lands where you retreat.

lines.zh: 你在数我的心跳，可惜数不清。
lines.en: You are counting my heartbeats; you will lose count.

lines.zh: 洞穴的岩壁会替我把你逼到角落。
lines.en: The cave wall will help me press you into a corner.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，好让背刺正中你的腰。
lines.en: I crouch low so my spines meet your waist.

lines.zh: 蕨叶响一下，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: One rustle of ferns tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 等你抬手，我才扑。
lines.en: I lunge only when your arm lifts.

lines.zh: 你越退，平原就越窄。
lines.en: The more you retreat, the narrower the plains get.

lines.zh: 我把重量放在后腿上，随时能起。
lines.en: I load my weight onto my hind legs, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 你在找出口，我在找角度。
lines.en: You look for an exit; I look for an angle.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在扫，扫出一块干净的战场。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a clean patch of ground to fight on.

lines.zh: 别停下来喘气，那是最好的时机。
lines.en: Do not stop to breathe; that is my best moment.

lines.zh: 你已经退到树边了，树不会帮你。
lines.en: You are against a tree now, and the tree will not help.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，数到五就起跳。
lines.en: I count your steps. On five, I leap.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你的甲会记住我的牙。
lines.en: One bite, and your armor will remember my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撕开的是肩，不是喉咙，先让你慢。
lines.en: I tear your shoulder, not your throat, so you slow first.

lines.zh: 爪子擦过，血在蕨叶上留了一行。
lines.en: My claws pass, leaving a line of blood on the ferns.

lines.zh: 九点五点的重量落在你胸口。
lines.en: Nine and a half points of weight land on your chest.

lines.zh: 你挡得不错，可惜只挡住一根刺。
lines.en: Good block, but you stopped only one spine.

lines.zh: 我的头一摆，你就飞出去半个身位。
lines.en: One swing of my head throws you half a body away.

lines.zh: 别用剑砍我的背，那里是四层甲。
lines.en: Do not cut my back; four layers of plate live there.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松，这是独居猎手的老规矩。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold; that is the solitary hunter's rule.

lines.zh: 你的盾在响，我的牙也在响。
lines.en: Your shield rings, and so do my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撞你膝盖，让你跪进泥里。
lines.en: I strike your knee and drop you into the mud.

lines.zh: 传说维度的猎物都这样倒下。
lines.en: Prey of Precasia all fall this way.

lines.zh: 这口是给你的甲，下一口给皮肤。
lines.en: That bite was for your armor; the next is for skin.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了把头甩得更狠。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to swing my skull harder.

lines.zh: 你还在站着，那我就再撕一次。
lines.en: You are still standing, so I will tear again.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处的水滴停了一下，我从暗处站起来。
lines.en: A drip in the cave pauses; I stand up out of the dark.

lines.zh: 传说维度的森林又少了一只鹿的份额。
lines.en: The forests of Precasia lose one more deer's share.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里挤出，背上还沾着石屑。
lines.en: I squeeze from a crack, rock dust still on my spines.

lines.zh: 洞穴、森林、丛林、平原，哪里都容得下我。
lines.en: Cave, forest, jungle, plains; all of them make room.

lines.zh: 这片地方还没有猎手，我来补上。
lines.en: This place has no hunter yet, so I fill the gap.

lines.zh: 我的爪子落在地上，草自己伏下去。
lines.en: My claws touch the ground, and the grass bows by itself.

lines.zh: 洞穴的黑暗里，多了一个呼吸。
lines.en: One more breath now exists in the cave's darkness.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着饥饿，这不算新鲜事。
lines.en: I was born hungry; that is nothing new.

lines.zh: 丛林让开一条缝，我从缝里走进来。
lines.en: The jungle parts a seam, and I walk through it.

lines.zh: 这里安静太久了，我来打破它。
lines.en: This place has been quiet too long; I break it.

lines.zh: 背刺先出现在光里，然后才是我的头。
lines.en: My spines enter the light first, then my head.

lines.zh: 平原上多了一道影子，那就是我。
lines.en: One more shadow on the plains; that is me.

lines.zh: 别问我是从哪来的，洞穴不回答。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from; the cave will not answer.

lines.zh: 我落地时，落叶全都翻了个面。
lines.en: When I land, every fallen leaf turns over.

lines.zh: 蕨叶底下醒来，背刺先撑开。
lines.en: I wake under the ferns, spines first.

lines.zh: 这片丛林的气味我还不熟。
lines.en: I do not know the smell of this jungle yet.

lines.zh: 烧我的鳞，你会闻到焦味。
lines.en: Burn my scales and you will smell them scorch.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我的甲先着地。
lines.en: Falling from a height, my armor lands first.

lines.zh: 洞穴的积水想留住我，我偏不。
lines.en: The cave pool tries to keep me; I refuse.

lines.zh: 炸开的石头比你的剑更疼。
lines.en: The shattered stone hurts worse than your blade.

lines.zh: 那支箭插在甲缝里，很扎。
lines.en: That arrow sits in a gap between plates and stings.

lines.zh: 这股冷光穿过了我的鳞。
lines.en: This cold light passed through my scales.

lines.zh: 猎物太少，我的腹部贴着脊骨。
lines.en: Too little prey; my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的背刺上，全导入土里。
lines.en: Lightning struck my spines and ran into the soil.

lines.zh: 虚空没有地面，我的爪子抓空了。
lines.en: The void has no floor, and my claws close on nothing.
